blocking_findings: The leaderboard visually emphasized total XP even though rank is ordered by season points.
The compact leaderboard had no visible horizontal-scroll affordance.
The integrity rationale control lacked a persistent visible label.
The manual EXP form relied on placeholders and lacked explicit adjustment guidance.
The collapsed season lifecycle control did not clearly communicate that it was interactive.
repair_batch: Season points are now the primary ranking metric and total XP is secondary.
Compact layouts now display an explicit horizontal-scroll cue.
Integrity and manual EXP workflows now use persistent visible field labels.
The manual EXP workflow now explains the audited additive action before submission.
The season lifecycle disclosure now explains what opening it manages.
evidence_limitations: This opinion was captured before the repair batch.
Only one independent critic was used to respect the one-subagent limit.
A fresh independent post-repair quorum remains required for a premium PASS.
